projects.title: Graduate Job Connect
projects.subtitle: Graduate employment and recruitment platform for Ethiopia
projects.description: A full-stack recruitment platform connecting graduates with employers and job opportunities across Ethiopia. Features role-based accounts for graduates, employers, and admins, with job discovery, applications, and email OTP verification.

projects.title: Currency Arbitrage Detector
projects.subtitle: Graph-based financial algorithm for detecting arbitrage opportunities
projects.description: A Python research project that models currency exchange markets as weighted directed graphs and detects potential arbitrage opportunities using the Bellman-Ford algorithm. Includes synthetic data generation and exchange rate analysis.

projects.title: ConnectHub
projects.subtitle: Social networking application with real-time interaction
projects.description: A social networking application built with Node.js and Express. Features user registration, authentication with JWT, social interaction, and real-time communication capabilities via Socket.IO.

projects.title: Ethiopian GPS Navigation System
projects.subtitle: Route analysis using graph algorithms and interactive maps
projects.description: A navigation and route analysis application that uses graph algorithms to find routes between Ethiopian cities. Built with Python and Flask, featuring interactive map visualizations powered by Folium and network analytics.

projects.title: MerkatoStock — Inventory Management
projects.subtitle: Web-based inventory system for business stock management
projects.description: A web-based inventory management system helping businesses manage products, suppliers, stock operations, and inventory records. Includes role-based access, CSV reporting, and activity logging.

projects.title: AI Learning Tutor
projects.subtitle: AI-based education assistant for students
projects.description: An AI-powered application to help students learn faster with personalized explanations, practice exercises, and guided feedback. Currently in active development.
